part2.audioText: When is the deadline for the grant application?
part2.explanation: When 問時間，(A)「這週五五點」正確。(B) 回答地點，(C) 疑問詞問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。

part2.audioText: Where did you park the company van?
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(B)「在卸貨區後面」正確。(A) 名詞答非所問，(C) 回答時間長度。

part2.audioText: Would you mind reviewing my presentation slides?
optionAudioTexts: Not at all. Send them over.
part2.explanation: Would you mind...? 請求協助，(A) Not at all（不介意，樂意幫忙）正確。注意：回答 mind 問句時 Not at all 表示答應。

part2.audioText: Is the cafeteria open during the renovation, or should we eat elsewhere?
optionAudioTexts: We'll need to eat elsewhere until next month.
part2.explanation: 選擇疑問句（餐廳有開還是要去別處吃），(C)「下個月前都要去別處吃」選了後者，正確。

part2.audioText: Haven't you met the new branch manager yet?
optionAudioTexts: No, I've been away on business.
part2.explanation: 否定疑問句問「你還沒見過新經理嗎」，(B)「還沒，我出差去了」正確。No 表示「還沒見過」。

part2.audioText: How often does the shuttle run between the two buildings?
part2.explanation: How often 問頻率，(B)「每十五分鐘一班」正確。(A) 回答人數，(C) 回答起始時間。

part2.audioText: Who's going to train the new customer service representatives?
optionAudioTexts: Mr. Silva volunteered to do it.
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(C)「Silva 先生自願負責」正確。(A) 用 train（火車）混淆 train（訓練）。

part2.audioText: You've already sent out the invitations, right?
optionAudioTexts: Yes, they went out this morning.
part2.explanation: 確認邀請函是否已寄出，(A)「是的，今天早上寄出了」正確。

script: M: Welcome to Grandview Apartments. What can I do for you?
W: Hi, I saw your listing online for a one-bedroom apartment on Maple Street. Is it still available?
M: Yes, it is. The rent is twelve hundred a month, which includes water and internet, but not electricity.
W: That's within my budget. Is the apartment close to public transportation? I commute downtown every day.
M: There's a subway station just a five-minute walk away. Would you like to see the apartment this week?
W: Yes, please. I'm free on Thursday after four o'clock.

questions.q: What is the woman inquiring about?
questions.explanation: 女子說在網路上看到 one-bedroom apartment 的出租資訊並詢問是否還在，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What is NOT included in the rent?
questions.explanation: 男子說 includes water and internet, but not electricity，電費不含在房租內，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What will the woman probably do on Thursday?
questions.explanation: 男子問要不要看房，女子回答週四四點後有空，可知她週四會去看房，故選 (C)。

script: W: Tom, the printing company just called. They said the brochures for the trade show won't be ready until Friday morning.
M: Friday morning? But our flight to the trade show leaves Thursday night. That's cutting it too close.
W: I know. I asked if they could rush the order, but they'd charge an extra two hundred dollars.
M: Hmm, that's a lot. What if we have the brochures delivered directly to the convention center instead?
W: That could work. The booth setup isn't until Saturday morning, so they'd arrive in time.
M: Perfect. Can you call them back and arrange the delivery? Make sure they send us a tracking number.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: Some brochures will not be ready in time.
A printer is out of ink.
questions.explanation: 女子說 the brochures won't be ready until Friday morning，但週四晚就要出發，印刷品來不及，故選 (B)。

options: Having the brochures delivered to the convention center
questions.explanation: 男子提議 have the brochures delivered directly to the convention center（直接寄到會展中心），故選 (C)。他覺得加急費太貴。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation: 男子說 Can you call them back and arrange the delivery?（回電安排配送），故選 (B)。

part4.script: Thank you all for coming to today's session on workplace safety. Before we begin, I'd like to remind everyone that this training is required for all warehouse employees, and you must sign the attendance sheet by the door before you leave. Today we'll cover three topics: proper lifting techniques, forklift safety, and emergency procedures. Please hold your questions until the end of each section. You'll find a handout on your chair summarizing the key points; keep it for future reference. After the session, there will be a short quiz, and you need a score of at least eighty percent to receive your safety certificate. Let's get started.

questions.q: Who is the talk intended for?
questions.explanation: this training is required for all warehouse employees，本訓練為倉儲人員必修，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What must listeners do before leaving?
questions.explanation: you must sign the attendance sheet by the door before you leave，離開前要在門邊簽到表簽名，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What is required to receive a certificate?
options: Scoring at least eighty percent on a quiz
questions.explanation: you need a score of at least eighty percent to receive your safety certificate，測驗需達 80 分才能拿到證書，故選 (B)。

part4.script: You've reached the voicemail of Chapter One Bookstore. Our store is open Monday through Saturday from nine A.M. to eight P.M., and Sunday from noon to six P.M. If you're calling to check whether a book is in stock, please visit our website, where our full inventory is updated every hour. For questions about our monthly book club, press one to leave a message for our events coordinator, and she will return your call within one business day. Please note that our annual clearance sale begins this Saturday, and all used books will be fifty percent off for one week only. We look forward to seeing you soon.

questions.q: What type of business does the message come from?
questions.explanation: 開頭說 You've reached the voicemail of Chapter One Bookstore（書店），故選 (B)。

questions.q: According to the message, what can callers do on the website?
questions.explanation: to check whether a book is in stock, please visit our website，查詢庫存請上網站，故選 (A)。

options: A book signing will be held.
questions.explanation: our annual clearance sale begins this Saturday，年度清倉特賣本週六開始，故選 (C)。

part5.q: Please make sure that all windows are locked ------- you leave the office.
part5.explanation: before + 子句 = 在…之前。「離開辦公室前請確認所有窗戶上鎖」。其餘介系詞語意不合。

part5.q: The design team worked ------- to meet the client's tight deadline.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 worked 用副詞 efficiently（有效率地）。「設計團隊有效率地工作以趕上期限」。

part5.q: ------- attending the conference remotely should test their internet connection in advance.
part5.explanation: Those + V-ing = 那些…的人（= people who attend）。「遠端與會者應事先測試網路連線」。

part5.q: The museum's new exhibition has attracted ------- visitors than expected.
part5.explanation: 句尾有 than，需要比較級 more。「新展覽吸引的參觀人數比預期多」。

part5.q: Employees may not use the company logo without written ------- from the legal department.
part5.explanation: written permission = 書面許可（不可數名詞）。permit 當名詞是「許可證」，前面通常加冠詞。

part5.q: ------- the report was submitted late, the committee agreed to review it.
part5.explanation: 空格後是完整子句，需要連接詞 Even though（即使）。Despite 與 Because of 是介系詞。「即使報告遲交，委員會仍同意審查」。

part5.q: The two companies signed an agreement to ------- on developing electric vehicle batteries.
part5.explanation: collaborate on = 合作進行…。「兩家公司簽約合作開發電動車電池」。compete 競爭與 agreement 語意矛盾。

part5.q: Ms. Novak will be out of the office ------- the end of next week.
part5.explanation: until = 直到…為止，表示狀態持續（不在辦公室的狀態持續到下週末）。by 用於一次性動作的期限。

part5.q: All laboratory equipment must be inspected ------- to ensure accurate results.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 be inspected 用副詞 regularly（定期地）。「所有實驗設備必須定期檢查」。

part5.q: ------- you have any questions about your benefits, please contact the HR office.
part5.explanation: Should you have... = If you should have...（假設語氣倒裝），常見於正式商業書信。「如有任何福利問題，請洽人資室」。

part5.q: The airline offers passengers a full refund or a travel voucher, ------- they prefer.
part5.explanation: whichever they prefer = 看他們偏好哪一個（兩個選項擇一）。「航空公司提供全額退款或旅遊券，任君選擇」。

part5.q: Construction of the new headquarters is expected to be ------- by early next year.
part5.explanation: be expected to be completed = 預計完工（被動語態）。「新總部預計明年初完工」。

part6.passage:
【Notice to Tenants】

Dear Residents of Parkside Tower,

Beginning next Monday, the building's water supply will be shut off [33] from 10:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M. for scheduled pipe maintenance. The work is expected to last three days and will be completed by Wednesday afternoon. We [34] that you store enough water in advance for drinking and washing during these hours. The elevator will remain in service, and access to the parking garage will not be [35]. We thank you for your patience while we improve the building's facilities. Questions may be directed to the management office in Suite 101.

questions.explanation: 維修持續三天、每天 10 點到 2 點停水，選 daily（每天）。
recommend that you store enough water = 建議您預先儲水。recommend that + 子句為正確句型。
access will not be affected = 進出不受影響。前文說電梯照常運作，此處指停車場出入也不受影響。

part6.passage:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Thank you for your interest in the Marketing Specialist position at Vantage Media. We were impressed by your application and would like to [36] you to an interview on Tuesday, August 11, at 10:00 A.M. The interview will take place at our downtown office and will last [37] one hour. Please bring a copy of your portfolio and two professional references. If the scheduled time is not convenient, contact our office by Friday to arrange an [38] time.

We look forward to meeting you.

Sincerely,
Hiring Team, Vantage Media

questions.explanation: invite you to an interview = 邀請您參加面試，求職信函常用語。
修飾 one hour 用副詞 approximately（大約）。「面試約一小時」。
arrange an alternative time = 另約其他時間。前句說如果原時間不方便，故選 alternative（替代的）。

part7.passage:
【Text-message chain】
Nina Park (10:12 A.M.)
Hi Jorge, are you at the office? The projector in Room 5 won't turn on, and my client presentation starts at 11.

Jorge Ramos (10:14 A.M.)
I'm out at the supplier's site until noon. Did you check whether the power strip under the table is switched on? It gets turned off by the cleaning crew sometimes.

Nina Park (10:16 A.M.)
Good call — it was off. The projector works now, but the screen colors look strange, kind of greenish.

Jorge Ramos (10:18 A.M.)
That's the cable. There's a spare HDMI cable in the supply room, second shelf. Swap it and you should be fine.

Nina Park (10:25 A.M.)
Perfect, that fixed it. Thanks so much! I owe you a coffee.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Park contact Mr. Ramos?
options: To invite him to a meeting
questions.explanation: 她說投影機打不開、11 點要向客戶簡報，是為了尋求設備協助，故選 (B)。

questions.q: At 10:16 A.M., what does Ms. Park mean when she writes, "Good call"?
options: She received an important phone call.
questions.explanation: Good call 意思是「你說得對／建議正確」。Jorge 猜延長線被關掉，結果確實如此，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What did Ms. Park most likely do at around 10:20 A.M.?
options: She went to the supplier's site.
questions.explanation: 10:18 Jorge 請她去備品室換 HDMI 線，10:25 她說 that fixed it，可推知她在這段時間換了線，故選 (C)。

part7.passage:
【Article】
RIVERTON (August 3) — The Riverton City Council announced yesterday that the downtown farmers' market will be extended through the end of October, two months longer than in previous years. The market, held every Saturday morning in Central Plaza, features fresh produce, baked goods, and handmade crafts from more than 40 local vendors.

"Attendance has grown every year since the market opened in 2021," said council spokesperson Dana Wells. "This summer we averaged over 3,000 visitors each week, so extending the season made sense." Local vendors welcomed the decision. "September and October are our best months for apples and pumpkins," said orchard owner Peter Lang. "Now we can sell directly to customers instead of only through grocery stores."

The council also plans to add twenty more parking spaces near the plaza and is considering a smaller indoor market during the winter months. A final decision on the winter market is expected in September.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a new grocery store
The extension of a farmers' market season
A change in city parking fees
A plan to renovate Central Plaza
questions.explanation: 文章主旨是市議會宣布農夫市集延長至十月底，比往年多兩個月，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What is suggested about the farmers' market?
options: It is held twice a week.
It has become more popular each year.
questions.explanation: 發言人說 Attendance has grown every year since the market opened in 2021，人氣逐年成長，故選 (B)。市集是每週六舉行、2021 年開辦。
文中稱 orchard owner Peter Lang（果園主人），故選 (C)。

questions.q: According to the article, what will the council decide in September?
options: Whether to hold an indoor winter market
questions.explanation: A final decision on the winter market is expected in September，冬季室內市集將於九月定案，故選 (A)。
